## Executive Summary

Previous session fixed 4 surface-level visual specs (heart class, radio layout, sidebar h1 typography, splash exit anim) but missed 7 deeper bugs because verification was based on file-size deltas + computed style + qualitative `look_at` of only 3 of 7 screens. Full audit now identifies 2 CRITICAL infrastructure bugs (favicon CSP, iframe X-Frame-Options), 3 HIGH content/i18n bugs, and 2 MEDIUM visual-fill bugs.

This plan fixes all 7 in 3 waves of build-test-verify, with full PNG verification per wave.

## Task Specifications

### Wave A — CRITICAL Infrastructure

#### F1: Search Engine Favicon URL Rewrite

**File**: `maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_welcome/maho_welcome_page_handler.cc`

**Why**: maho-welcome's default `img-src` CSP allows only `chrome://` schemes. Returning raw `https://` favicon URL → CSP violation → Chromium broken-image placeholder.

**Edit 1 — add include after existing `string_util.h` include**:
```cpp
#include "base/strings/escape.h"
```

**Edit 2 — replace line 251**:
```cpp
// OLD
info->icon_url = turl->favicon_url().spec();

// NEW
std::string raw_favicon = turl->favicon_url().spec();
if (!raw_favicon.empty()) {
  info->icon_url = "chrome://favicon2/?size=32&scaleFactor=1x&iconUrl=" +
      base::EscapeQueryParamValue(raw_favicon, /*use_plus=*/false);
}
```

**Why this works**: `chrome://favicon2/` is in default `img-src` allowlist set by `SetupWebUIDataSource`. `FaviconSource` is globally registered by Chromium; no per-WebUI registration needed.

**GN risk**: NONE. `base::EscapeQueryParamValue` is in `//base` (already a dep).

**Acceptance**: Screen 4 PNG shows colored Google/Naver/Bing/Daum/Cốc Cốc favicons (not broken-image placeholders).

**Effort**: 3 minutes

---

#### F2: chrome://maho-space-create iframe Embedding Fix

**File**: `maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_space_create/maho_space_create_ui.cc`

**Why**: Default `WebUIDataSource` sets `deny_xframe_options_=true` (X-Frame-Options: DENY) and empty `frame_ancestors_` set (CSP `frame-ancestors 'none'`). Both block embedding. `maho_welcome_ui.cc` already has correct `frame-src chrome://maho-space-create;` CSP.

**Edit 1 — add include**:
```cpp
#include "url/gurl.h"
```

**Edit 2 — after `webui::SetupWebUIDataSource(...)` call (≈line 32), add**:
```cpp
source->AddFrameAncestor(GURL(maho::kMahoWelcomeURL));
source->DisableDenyXFrameOptions();
```

**CRITICAL**: Both calls required. `AddFrameAncestor` adds `frame-ancestors` CSP but does NOT auto-clear X-Frame-Options. `kMahoWelcomeURL` already imported via `webui_url_constants.h`.

**GN risk**: NONE. `//url` already a dep.

**Acceptance**: Screen 6 right pane PNG shows theme picker UI (color swatches, mode chips visible).

**Effort**: 3 minutes

## Verification Protocol — Lessons from Previous Failure

**Previous session false-positive failure mode**: claimed "all visual specs match" based only on (a) file size deltas, (b) computed style JSON, (c) `look_at` of 3 of 7 screens. User correctly identified that 4 of the 7 screens had unresolved bugs.

**This plan's verification gate**:
1. **PNG-first verification**: every fix has a designated screen + a designated `look_at` description that MUST match
2. **No "computed style only" passes**: computed styles are supplementary evidence, never primary
3. **Per-wave full PNG capture**: not just affected screens — capture all 7 each wave to catch unintended regressions
4. **Acceptance phrasing**: each fix has a single binary observable ("colored favicons visible" / "ring+dot anchor visible") not vague ("looks better")

## NEW Bugs Discovered During Execution

### F1b — Search Engine Brand Logos Missing

**Symptom**: After F1a (URL rewrite + FaviconSource registered), favicons render as Chromium's default fallback globe instead of Google G / Naver N / Bing / Daum / Cốc Cốc brand logos.

**Root Cause Hypothesis** (untested — needs explore agent):
- `chrome://favicon2/?iconUrl=...` only returns favicons FROM CHROME'S CACHE
- Prepopulated search engines never have user-visited pages → no cached favicon
- `&allowGoogleServerFallback=1` should fetch via Google's t0.gstatic.com favicon service, but Maho's network/policy stack may block this (unverified)

**Possible Fixes** (need agent diagnosis to pick):

## F1b — Search Engine Brand Logos (PLAN ONLY)

### Confirmed Root Cause (definitive)

`chrome://favicon2/?iconUrl=...` is a **DB-only lookup** via `FaviconService::GetRawFavicon`. It NEVER triggers a network fetch. Prepopulated search engines have never been visited → no DB cache entry → returns `IDR_DEFAULT_FAVICON` (generic gray globe).

`&allowGoogleServerFallback=1` is **dead code in this context**. Per `chromium/src/chrome/browser/ui/webui/favicon_source.cc::IsOriginAllowedServerFallback()`:
```cpp
// Only these 3 origins permit Google's t0.gstatic.com fallback:
allowed = (origin == "chrome://history" ||
           origin == "chrome://newtab" ||
           origin == "chrome://data-sharing");
```
`chrome://maho-welcome` is not allowlisted → fallback silently no-ops.

`chrome://theme/IDR_GOOGLE_IMAGE` (the upstream `chrome://search-engine-choice` approach) **also doesn't work** because `BUILDFLAG_INTERNAL_ENABLE_BUILTIN_SEARCH_PROVIDER_ASSETS()` is `(0)` in Maho's open-source build (only Google-internal-branded builds have those PNG assets compiled into the PAK). `TemplateURL::GetBuiltinImageResourceId()` returns `"IDR_DEFAULT_FAVICON"` for all engines in Maho.

### Confirmed Prepopulate IDs (from `prepopulated_engines.json`)

| Engine | `prepopulate_id` | favicon URL in JSON |
|--------|-----------------:|---------------------|
| Google | 1 | googleg_alldp.ico |
| Microsoft Bing | 3 | www.bing.com/favicon.ico |
| Naver (네이버) | 67 | ssl.pstatic.net/.../favicon_140327.ico |
| Daum | 68 | search.daum.net/favicon.ico |
| Cốc Cốc | 91 | coccoc.com/favicon.ico |

### Recommended Strategy: Option A (Bundle 5 PNGs) + Option D fallback

**Why Option A**:
- Smallest change surface — 2 source files modified + 5 binary assets
- Zero new C++ deps (no Mojom changes, no async plumbing)
- Privacy-perfect — zero network requests
- Matches existing pattern (`icons/essentials/` already serves bundled SVGs the same way)
- Full Chromium rebuild NOT required — incremental build sufficient after resource changes

**Why NOT other options**:
- Option B (FaviconService pre-fetch): ~150 lines async plumbing + 5 HTTP requests on every welcome screen render → privacy regression
- Option C (accept globe): unacceptable UX for first-run wizard where brand recognition matters
- Option D alone: typographic letter marks only (no actual logos) — keep as fallback for unknown engines

### F1b Implementation Spec (atomic — single commit)

**Touch list**:

   - `bing.png` (32×32, blue B on white)
   - `naver.png` (32×32, green N on white)
   - `daum.png` (32×32, orange D on white)
   - `coccoc.png` (32×32, red Ć on white)

**No `deps` changes needed.** `build_webui()` template auto-generates GRD entries.

3. **`maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_welcome/maho_welcome_page_handler.cc`** — replace lines 251-258 (current F1a code):
```cpp

```

## F2b — chrome://maho-space-create iframe Mojo Bindings (PLAN ONLY)

### Confirmed Root Cause (definitive — direct quote from Chromium source)

`chromium/src/content/browser/webui/web_ui_impl.cc:293-301`:
```cpp
void WebUIImpl::SetUpMojoConnection() {
  // TODO(nasko): WebUI mojo might be useful to be registered for
  // subframes as well, though at this time there is no such usage
  if (frame_host_->GetParentOrOuterDocument())
    return;  // ← BAILS for the space-create iframe

  frame_host_->GetFrameBindingsControl()->BindWebUI(...);
}
```

This is THE smoking gun. `BindWebUI` is what injects `window.Mojo` global into the renderer. For ANY chrome:// scheme WebUI loaded as a subframe, this method returns immediately. The renderer's JS sees `Mojo is not defined` because the bridge was never set up.

**Three subframe guards** are present (`web_ui_impl.cc:293`, `:330`, indirectly `:201` via `WebUIMainFrameObserver`). All three fire for chrome:// embedded iframes.

### `enable_chrome_send=true` is a RED HERRING

`mojo_web_ui_controller.cc:11-23`:
```cpp
content::BindingsPolicySet bindings(
    {content::BindingsPolicyValue::kMojoWebUi});  // ← always set
if (enable_chrome_send) {
    bindings.Put(content::BindingsPolicyValue::kWebUi);  // ← only adds chrome.send
}
```

`kMojoWebUi` (which controls `window.Mojo`) is set **regardless** of `enable_chrome_send`. The flag only adds `chrome.send` (legacy IPC). Setting `enable_chrome_send=true` on `MahoSpaceCreateUI` would **NOT** fix the Mojo iframe failure. Do not attempt this fix.

### Architectural Solution: chrome-untrusted:// scheme

`UntrustedWebUIController` uses a **completely different binding path** that bypasses all three subframe guards. `chrome-untrusted://` was designed by the Chromium team specifically for the WebUI-in-WebUI iframe pattern.

**Production reference**: `chromium/src/chrome/browser/ui/webui/ntp_microsoft_auth/ntp_microsoft_auth_untrusted_ui.cc` — a chrome-untrusted:// inner WebUI embedded inside the chrome://newtab outer WebUI, using Mojo bindings successfully.

### ADR Compatibility (CRITICAL — needs user clarification)

`maho-chromium/AGENTS.md` ANTI-PATTERNS section states:
> **Theme picker is permanently `chrome://maho-space-create`** — Do NOT migrate it to `maho_space_config`. Do NOT resurrect a native Views theme picker. Do NOT introduce a second production WebUI for theme selection.

**Strict reading**:
- "permanently `chrome://maho-space-create`" → scheme migration MAY be prohibited
- "Do NOT migrate it to `maho_space_config`" → migration to a DIFFERENT WebUI host prohibited
- "Do NOT introduce a second production WebUI for theme selection" → dual-controller approach (Option B2 below) MAY be prohibited

**Open question for user**: does this ADR ban scheme change while keeping host name `maho-space-create`?

### Two Sub-Strategies Within Option B (chrome-untrusted)

#### Option B1 — Full Scheme Migration

Move `MahoSpaceCreateUI` from `chrome://maho-space-create` to `chrome-untrusted://maho-space-create`. Native dialog (Views WebView) loads new URL.

**Pros**: Clean architecture, single source of truth, follows upstream convention
**Cons**: ADR ambiguity — may need amendment; `maho_space_theme_picker_dialog.cc:57` URL constant changes; affects all entry points

**Files to modify** (~6 files):

1. **`maho-chromium/components/constants/webui_url_constants.{h,cc}`**:
```cpp
// BEFORE:
inline constexpr char kMahoSpaceCreateURL[] = "chrome://maho-space-create/";
inline constexpr char kMahoSpaceCreateHost[] = "maho-space-create";

// AFTER:
inline constexpr char kMahoSpaceCreateURL[] = "chrome-untrusted://maho-space-create/";
inline constexpr char kMahoSpaceCreateHost[] = "maho-space-create";
// (host string unchanged; only scheme changes via constants)
```

2. **`maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_space_create/maho_space_create_ui.{h,cc}`**:
```cpp

// AFTER:  ui::UntrustedWebUIController + content::kChromeUIUntrustedScheme

// .h:
class MahoSpaceCreateUIConfig : public DefaultWebUIConfig<MahoSpaceCreateUI> {
 public:
  MahoSpaceCreateUIConfig()
      : DefaultWebUIConfig(content::kChromeUIUntrustedScheme,
                           maho::kMahoSpaceCreateHost) {}
};

class MahoSpaceCreateUI : public ui::UntrustedWebUIController {
  // remove BindInterface/CreatePageHandler if Mojo bindings work via different path
  // OR keep them but adjust pattern per UntrustedWebUIController template
};

// .cc constructor:
MahoSpaceCreateUI::MahoSpaceCreateUI(content::WebUI* web_ui)
    : UntrustedWebUIController(web_ui) {
  content::WebUIDataSource* source = content::WebUIDataSource::CreateAndAdd(
      Profile::FromWebUI(web_ui),
      base::StrCat({chrome::kChromeUIUntrustedScheme,
                    "://", maho::kMahoSpaceCreateHost, "/"}));  // full URL
  webui::SetupWebUIDataSource(source, kMahoSpaceCreateResources,
                              IDR_MAHO_SPACE_CREATE_SPACE_CREATE_HTML);
  source->AddFrameAncestor(GURL(maho::kMahoWelcomeURL));
  source->DisableDenyXFrameOptions();
  // CRITICAL: explicit Mojo script CSP allowlist for chrome-untrusted scheme
  source->OverrideContentSecurityPolicy(
      network::mojom::CSPDirectiveName::ScriptSrc,
      "script-src chrome-untrusted://resources/mojo/mojo/public/js/bindings.js "
      "'self' 'unsafe-inline';");
}
```

#### Option B2 — Dual Controller (Coexistence)

Keep `MahoSpaceCreateUI` at `chrome://` for the native dialog. Add a NEW `MahoSpaceCreateUntrustedUI` at `chrome-untrusted://maho-space-create` for the welcome wizard iframe ONLY.

**Pros**: ADR-safe (chrome:// theme picker untouched for dialog use case); minimal risk to existing dialog path
**Cons**: Two controllers sharing one Mojom + page handler; some code duplication; ADR's "no second production WebUI" clause is borderline

**Files to modify** (~7 files):

Most code duplicates the existing controller; differs only in base class + scheme constant.

## F1b FINAL — Vendor Brave Leo SVGs

### Asset Source DECIDED

**Source**: [`brave/leo`](https://github.com/brave/leo) repository, commit `ed35a435ecd5b8f9a856d62db7ab07eb33f03c2d` (verified by librarian agent 2026-06-12).

**Why this beats other options**:
- ✅ Brave is itself an open-source Chromium fork — **identical legal posture to Maho**
- ✅ MPL 2.0 license (compatible with Maho's licensing)
- ✅ SVG format — scales perfectly, no PNG conversion needed, smaller bundle
- ✅ Professionally designed brand-color marks (not hand-drawn approximations)
- ✅ Uses nominative-fair-use precedent that ALL major browsers rely on (Chrome, Firefox, Brave, Vivaldi all ship search engine logos this way)
- ✅ Pre-existing 24×24 viewBox — works in any size container including our 32×32 target

**Why NOT other options**:
- ❌ Zen Browser: doesn't bundle, uses Firefox CDN at runtime — not an asset source
- ❌ Firefox Remote Settings CDN URLs: Mozilla infrastructure, can change, breaking dependency
- ❌ Hand-drawn Maho-original (my prev A2 recommendation): wastes ~30min, lower quality, no precedent
- ❌ Bitmap downloads from .ico URLs: rasterization quality loss, license less clean

### Files to Vendor (5 total)

Source paths in `brave/leo` repo (commit `ed35a435`):
```
icons/google-color.svg
icons/bing-color.svg
icons/naver-color.svg
icons/daum-color.svg
icons/coc-coc-color.svg
```

Destination paths in `maho-chromium`:

```
maho-chromium/browser/resources/maho_welcome/icons/search-engines/bing.svg
maho-chromium/browser/resources/maho_welcome/icons/search-engines/naver.svg
maho-chromium/browser/resources/maho_welcome/icons/search-engines/daum.svg
maho-chromium/browser/resources/maho_welcome/icons/search-engines/coccoc.svg
```

Per Maho conventions (Brave Leo is MPL 2.0, Maho's `LICENSES/` dir handles this), each vendored SVG should retain or get added an SPDX comment:
```xml
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0 -->
<!-- Sourced from brave/leo @ ed35a435ecd5b8f9a856d62db7ab07eb33f03c2d -->
<!-- icons/{engine}-color.svg -->
```

Add `LICENSES/brave-leo-icons.txt` if not present (BraveSoftware copyright + MPL 2.0 boilerplate).

3. **`maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_welcome/maho_welcome_page_handler.cc`** — replace lines 251-258 (current F1a code):
```cpp
// Prepopulated search engines have no cached favicon (user has never visited
// the page), so chrome://favicon2 returns the generic globe. We bundle Brave
// Leo SVGs (MPL 2.0, brave/leo @ ed35a435) and select by prepopulate_id.
static constexpr struct {
  int id;
  const char* path;
} kBundledSearchEngineFavicons[] = {
    {1,  "chrome://maho-welcome/icons/search-engines/google.svg"},
    {3,  "chrome://maho-welcome/icons/search-engines/bing.svg"},
    {67, "chrome://maho-welcome/icons/search-engines/naver.svg"},
    {68, "chrome://maho-welcome/icons/search-engines/daum.svg"},
    {91, "chrome://maho-welcome/icons/search-engines/coccoc.svg"},
};
bool found = false;
for (const auto& entry : kBundledSearchEngineFavicons) {
  if (turl->prepopulate_id() == entry.id) {
    info->icon_url = entry.path;
    found = true;
    break;
  }
}
if (!found) {
  // Non-prepopulated/custom engines: try favicon2 (cache-only fallback)
  std::string raw_favicon = turl->favicon_url().spec();
  if (!raw_favicon.empty()) {
    info->icon_url =
        "chrome://favicon2/?size=32&scaleFactor=1x&iconUrl=" +
        base::EscapeQueryParamValue(raw_favicon, /*use_plus=*/false);
  }
}
```

```
[full MPL 2.0 boilerplate]
```

## F2b FINAL — D2 Open Existing Dialog

### Strategy DECIDED: D2 (Open MahoSpaceThemePickerDialog from welcome wizard)

Per ADR analysis:
- **B1 (chrome-untrusted scheme migration)** — likely violates "permanently chrome://maho-space-create" intent
- **B2 (dual controller)** — EXPLICIT VIOLATION of ADR #3 ("Second production WebUI surface for theme picking — No alternative URL")
- **C (inline React picker in welcome)** — heavyweight (~4-8hr), code duplication, but ADR-safe
- **D2 (open existing dialog)** — ADR-PERFECT (zero changes to chrome://maho-space-create or its WebUI surface), LIGHTWEIGHT (~1-2hr), reuses production code path
- **E (skip Theme step)** — loses Zen-parity scope

**D2 is the ONLY option that is BOTH ADR-perfect AND lightweight.**

### Architecture (D2)

```
Welcome wizard Theme step (chrome://maho-welcome)
└── React component renders: <button onClick={onPickTheme}>Pick a Theme</button>
└── Inline preview shows currently selected theme (color swatch from store)
└── onPickTheme() → store.openThemePickerDialog()
    └── Mojo: WelcomePage.OpenThemePickerDialog() → Browser process
        └── MahoWelcomePageHandler::OpenThemePickerDialog(callback)
            └── MahoSpaceThemePickerDialog::Open(browser, current_theme_json, callback)
                └── (Production path — already exists, fully tested)
                    └── User picks theme in dialog
                        └── Dialog closes, callback fires with new theme_json
                            └── Page handler returns theme_json via Mojo
                                └── React store updates selectedTheme
                                    └── Wizard "Next" button enabled
```

**Crucial**: This routes through the EXACT SAME `MahoSpaceThemePickerDialog::Open()` API that the sidebar "Choose a Theme" production path uses. ADR canonical path preserved 100%.

### F2b Implementation Spec (D2 — atomic, single commit)

**Touch list (5 source files)**:

1. **`maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_welcome/maho_welcome.mojom`** — add new method to PageHandler interface:
```mojom
interface PageHandler {
  // ... existing methods ...

  // Opens the production theme picker dialog and returns the picked theme JSON.
  // Returns empty string if user cancelled.
  OpenThemePickerDialog(string current_theme_json) => (string picked_theme_json);
};
```

2. **`maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_welcome/maho_welcome_page_handler.h`** — add method declaration:
```cpp
void OpenThemePickerDialog(const std::string& current_theme_json,
                           OpenThemePickerDialogCallback callback) override;
```

3. **`maho-chromium/browser/ui/webui/maho_welcome/maho_welcome_page_handler.cc`** — add implementation + include:
```cpp
#include "maho/browser/ui/views/space_create/maho_space_theme_picker_dialog.h"

void MahoWelcomePageHandler::OpenThemePickerDialog(
    const std::string& current_theme_json,
    OpenThemePickerDialogCallback callback) {
  if (!browser_) {
    std::move(callback).Run("");  // empty = treated as cancelled by client
    return;
  }
  // Reuse production theme picker dialog (per ADR canonical path).
  // Open() signature (verified from
  // browser/ui/views/space_create/maho_space_theme_picker_dialog.h):
  //   static views::Widget* Open(
  //       Browser* browser,
  //       const std::string& initial_theme_json,
  //       base::OnceCallback<void(const std::string& committed_theme_json,
  //                               bool cancelled)> on_result);
  // Dialog manages its own lifecycle (singleton). Return value ignored.
  MahoSpaceThemePickerDialog::Open(
      browser_,
      current_theme_json,
      base::BindOnce(
          [](OpenThemePickerDialogCallback cb,
             const std::string& committed_theme_json,
             bool cancelled) {
            // If user cancelled, return empty string; otherwise committed JSON.
            std::move(cb).Run(cancelled ? std::string() : committed_theme_json);
          },
          std::move(callback)));
}
```

**API verification provenance**: read `maho-chromium/browser/ui/views/space_create/maho_space_theme_picker_dialog.h` 2026-06-12 (53 lines, signed-off contract). Initial v4 spec had wrong callback shape (single param); corrected here.

4. **`maho-chromium/browser/resources/maho_welcome/react/pages/space-theme.tsx`** — replace iframe with button:

```tsx
      background: deriveGradient(selectedTheme),
    }} />

  <button
    type="button"
    className="welcome-theme-picker-button"
    onClick={async () => {
      const currentJson = selectedTheme ?? '';
      const result = await store.openThemePickerDialog(currentJson);
      if (result) {
        store.setSelectedTheme(result);
      }
    }}>
    {selectedTheme
      ? store.getString('IDS_MAHO_WELCOME_THEME_CHANGE')
      : store.getString('IDS_MAHO_WELCOME_THEME_PICK')}
  </button>
</div>
```
